facts.text: Vassar's open curriculum has no core classes or distribution requirements, allowing students to take the courses that most interest them.

sources.title: Explore Academics - Vassar College
sources.quote: With no core classes or distribution requirements, you can choose to take the courses that most interest you and know that your classmates are fully engaged.

facts.text: Vassar meets 100% of the full demonstrated financial need of all admitted students for all four years.
